summary: Backend-only verification that POST /api/daily-reports/{id}/weather-autofill never returns a 5xx status (which would be intercepted by Cloudflare as a 520 HTML page). Grep of the endpoint confirmed all 7 `raise HTTPException` calls use 404/409/422 only. Wrote 9 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_weather_autofill_no_5xx.py covering: happy path (real Kansas City / MO Open-Meteo call), no city/state, bad DR id, project deleted after DR created, submitted/locked DR, and 4 simulated Open-Meteo failure modes (geocode unreachable, weather unreachable, geocode timeout >6s, weather timeout >6s) via monkeypatching _geocode/_fetch_weather through in-process ASGI transport. ALL 9 TESTS PASSED. Every failure path returns a 4xx (< 500) with Content-Type application/json and a short (<200 char) `detail` string. The 504/502 -> 422 conversion is verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: weather_autofill body's docstring still references '504' as the timeout status ('return a clean 504 the frontend can toast cleanly.'). The code now returns 422 -- the docstring at lines 1621-1623 of daily_reports_router.py should be updated to say 422 to avoid future confusion during on-call.

The `_geocode` and `_fetch_weather` helpers swallow ALL exceptions with a bare `except Exception:` returning None. This is intentional for the current 'return 422 on any failure' contract, but the swallowed exception is not logged anywhere, so operators debugging a mass Open-Meteo outage will have zero backend logs. Consider `logger.warning(...)` inside the except blocks so ops can distinguish DNS failure vs 5xx from provider vs timeout.
daily_reports_router.py is 2193 lines -- exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting weather-autofill helpers into a dedicated services/weather.py module for testability and readability.
test_credentials: Ephemeral registrations per-run (wxqa+<timestamp>@example.com / TestPass123!) via /api/auth/register. Wiped at end of run.
seed_data_creation: None persisted -- all test tenants dropped from MongoDB post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_weather_autofill_no_5xx.py is the regression suite for the Cloudflare-5xx fix. Run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_weather_autofill_no_5xx.py -o asyncio_mode=auto`. The in-process monkeypatch tests use a function-scoped ASGI fixture that rebinds motor to the current event loop; keep that pattern when adding more monkeypatched endpoint tests. iteration_13.json covered frontend sanitizer; iteration_14 covers backend status codes.
rca of the issue: Root cause (from prior iteration): Cloudflare intercepts any origin 5xx and substitutes a 520 HTML error page BEFORE the browser sees the JSON body. Fix: convert the two `asyncio.wait_for(timeout=6.0)` TimeoutError branches from HTTP 504 -> 422, and the 'weather fetch returned None' branch from HTTP 502 -> 422 (all at lines 1652/1662/1664 of routers/daily_reports_router.py). 422 is a 4xx that Cloudflare passes through untouched, so the axios .catch on the frontend sees {detail: '...'} and renders the friendly toast. Verified: every code path in weather_autofill now returns a 4xx (404/409/422) and JSON. No further action required.
